result.instructions: Tools for Desk365, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tickets are still open and unassigned right now?"; "Show me the urgent tickets from this week and who is working on them."; "Summarise the conversation on ticket 1042.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Desk365 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run desk365_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run desk365_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run desk365_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. desk365_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: desk365_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets, newest first by default, with subject, status, priority (1 Low, 5 Medium, 10 High, 20 Urgent), source, assignee, group, category, contact, company, SLA and dates. Filter by status, priority, type, group, assignee, category, contact, company or source. Use "--" in a list to match unassigned/empty. Descriptions are left out unless include_description is set. GET /v3/tickets.

source.description: Ticket sources: 1 Email, 5 Microsoft Teams, 6 Support Portal, 7 Phone/Other, 12 Web Form, 13 Web Widget, 15 API.

updated_since.description: Only tickets with any activity after this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

include_survey_details.description: Include the latest survey rating (default false).

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Full-text search over tickets, most relevant first. Searches subject and ticket number by default; widen it with search_in (description, replies and notes, attachment names, custom fields, contacts and companies, archived tickets). Double quotes around a phrase match it exactly; *text* matches inside words. GET /v3/tickets/search.

query.description: The text to look for, e.g. "printer not working".

search_in.description: Where to look (default: all supported fields).

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Everything on one ticket by its number: subject, description, status, priority, source, assignee, group, category, contact, company, SLA, due date, response/resolution durations (minutes), custom fields, watchers. GET /v3/tickets/details.

tools.name: desk365_get_ticket_conversations
tools.title: Get ticket conversation
tools.description: The conversation on a ticket: customer replies, agent replies, private and public notes and forwarded messages, each with sender, recipients, HTML and plain-text body, attachment details and time. The original description is not included (it is on desk365_get_ticket). GET /v3/tickets/conversations.

newest_first.description: Newest message on top (default: earliest first).

tools.name: desk365_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers/requesters), 30 per call, sorted by name by default, optionally only those of one company. GET /v3/contacts.

company.description: Only the contacts of this company (company name).

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by primary email (or, if the primary is not known, a secondary email): name, title, phones, company, departments, custom fields. GET /v3/contacts/details.

secondary_email.description: The contact's secondary email (used only when no primary email is given).

tools.name: desk365_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (customer organisations), 30 per call, sorted by name. GET /v3/companies.

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: One company by exact name: description, phone, address, SLA, domains, departments, custom fields. GET /v3/companies/details.

tools.name: desk365_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List logged time entries (ticket, agent, minutes, billable, note), filtered by ticket, agent, company, billable flag, running timers or date ranges. GET /v3/time_entries.

billable.description: true = billable only, false = non-billable only.

started_after.description: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (or just yyyy-mm-dd), in the helpdesk's timezone.

started_before.description: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (or just yyyy-mm-dd), in the helpdesk's timezone.

created_after.description: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (or just yyyy-mm-dd), in the helpdesk's timezone.

updated_after.description: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (or just yyyy-mm-dd), in the helpdesk's timezone.

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get time entry
tools.description: One time entry by id. GET /v3/time_entries/details.

tools.name: desk365_list_survey_ratings
tools.title: List survey ratings
tools.description: Customer satisfaction survey ratings (type 1 CSAT, 2 five-star, 3 NPS), oldest reply first, 30 per call. GET /v3/surveys/ratings.

offset.description: Offset into the result list (default 0). Desk365 returns the next page of results from this offset.

tools.name: desk365_list_kb_articles
tools.title: List knowledge base articles
tools.description: The titles of all live knowledge base articles. Open one with desk365_get_kb_article. GET /v3/kb/article/.

tools.name: desk365_get_kb_article
tools.title: Get knowledge base article
tools.description: A live knowledge base article by its exact title: HTML and plain-text content, category, folder, author, views, likes and status (0 unpublished, 1 published). GET /v3/kb/article/details.
